notes:
Compass. The floor plan's top is real south, not north: the 14:55 car shadows at the porch, the 16:10 table shadows on the north lawn and the sunlit (213) / back-lit (226) Auditorium glazing only agree with the afternoon sun if the porch faces south. The site plan keeps the floor plan's orientation; the arrow shows real north. Facade names below use the real compass.

Model. Main block 37.6 x 11.1 m, two storeys, 5.3 m high; Auditorium 13.0 x 8.2 m, single storey, 2.7 m; the shell is unchanged. The real building is taller, the real Auditorium is a double-height hall about three times larger, and the real passage is wider and roofed: those are the main remaining differences to the photos.

Added (new objects only): terrain and bank, clay paving, parking bays, murram road, kerbs, lawns, terraces with stone faces, porch floor and steps, railings, passage floor and canopy, water tanks, column cladding, piers, panels, fascia, roof, signage, AC units, solar street lights, trees, palms, shrubs and hedges, neighbouring blocks. Left out: people, vehicles, flags, the event tent and tables.
